findingDetails.title: An or-list refusal that names its second command as "the /x command" still attaches that command
findingDetails.scopeProof: COMMAND_OR_LIST is applied only to COMMAND_DECLINE_LEADS, and no test row covers an article inside the or-list (command-attach-guards.vitest.ts:155-174).
findingDetails.claim: A refusal that joins its commands with "or the <cmd> command" still yields a command offer.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: All five passing or-list rows use a bare /cmd or /cmd shape; the decline-lead comment constrains the words before the lead, not the list item article.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The authors may intend only the bare /cmd or /cmd form as an or-list, but the same commit added (?:the )? to the question lead, so the article is natural wording elsewhere.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If a packet doc or spec declares "or the <cmd> command" outside the refusal grammar contract, downgrade to P2.
